high_level_description: This is a black-and-white photograph from 1933, as indicated by the caption. The image shows two young men posing together outdoors. The man on the left has short hair and is wearing a light-colored sweater and trousers with a belt. He has his arm around the other man's waist and is smiling while looking up at him. The man on the right also has short hair and is wearing a light-colored sweater over a collared shirt and trousers. He is smiling and has one hand raised, possibly gesturing or adjusting something.
